machine: desktop 3-axis, Ø6 mm flat end mill (template; edit for your machine)
description: Partial CNC-3axis screen. It evaluates wall/feature/gap, circular-bore tool radius (a cutter of radius r cannot enter a bore narrower than 2r) and hole aspect (depth/diameter). It does NOT evaluate non-circular pockets/slots (needs a voxel reachability sweep), undercuts, minimum internal radius, setups/fixturing, chatter or cost. This is a screen, not a machinability certificate.

source.ref: template for 6061-T6; calibrate on your machine

wallMinMm.detail: Thin walls deflect during milling; 1.0mm is a conservative starting point for a desktop machine.

source.ref: template; small pins/bosses break or deflect
template; smaller slots need a smaller cutter

overhangDeg.reason: CNC removes material; there is no support overhang.

bridgeMaxMm.reason: No unsupported span is created by material removal.

source.ref: HSS drill 4:1 conservative; carbide/peck drilling can go deeper

holeAspectMax.detail: Depth / diameter. Applies to circular bores only.

draftMinDeg.reason: No mold release; draft does not govern machining.

toolRadiusMm.detail: Circular bores only: a bore radius below the cutter radius cannot be entered. Non-circular pockets/slots are NOT covered.

tolMm.detail: A capability; excluding on it needs a declared tolerance requirement.

surfaceRaUm.detail: Reported for information only; never used to exclude.

notes: Every number is a template (`rule-of-thumb`), not a calibration. The honest verdict is partial: circular bores, wall/feature/gap are screened; non-circular pockets, undercuts, min internal radius, setups, chatter and cost are handoffs.
